A bedroom entry door is visibly opened around frame 1480, but no reliable matching closing transition is visible, so it is not included as a completed on/off episode.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living area, utility/laundry spaces, and bedroom. The user opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, several cabinet or closet doors, and a bedroom closet.
